proposed_widenings.name: DiceExpr.abilityModifierAddend
proposed_widenings.justification: The item reduces incoming damage by a rolled amount plus Dexterity modifier, but DiceExpr only supports flat addends and spellcastingMod.
proposed_widenings.evidence: reduce the damage by 1d10 plus your Dexterity modifier

proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.free_hand
proposed_widenings.justification: The reaction is gated on having a free hand, and the existing equipment predicate vocabulary cannot express that requirement.
proposed_widenings.evidence: if you have a free hand

proposed_widenings.name: catch_projectile_on_zero_damage
proposed_widenings.justification: The item has a conditional follow-up rider when the reduction drops the triggering damage to 0, but the current surface has no honest item/object catch-transfer representation for that case.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If you reduce the damage to 0, you can catch the ammunition or weapon if it is small enough for you to hold in that hand.

notes: Family fit is magic_item triggered_reaction, but authoring would be dishonest without a non-spell ability-modifier addend and a free-hand gate. No content/tracer files were written.
